articles.title: Bruised Trump plots 2028 'influence' play after midterm shellacking: report
articles.description: President Donald Trump has privately told his advisers of a plan “aimed at salvaging his clout” after Republicans’ historic midterm defeat this week, one that would help him “influence elections in 2028 and beyond,” Axios reported Friday. Democrats flipped at least seven GOP-held Senate seats and, according to network projections, are on track to hold more than 250 House seats, handing the party control of both chambers in January. Trump’s plan, Axios exclusively reported, will involve continued fundraising for his political operation, either through his super PAC MAGA Inc. or through other venues. The operation would give Trump “a way to pressure GOP lawmakers who consider breaking with him as the president enters his lame-duck era,” much as it had leading up to the midterms with the defeat of Rep. Thomas Massie (R-KY) and Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX). Trump-backed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton ousted Cornyn in a May runoff — then lost Tuesday to Democratic state Rep. James Talarico, the first Democrat to win a U.S. Senate seat in Texas since 1988. MAGA Inc. spent in excess of $400 million on the midterms, Axios reported, citing an unnamed source “familiar with the totals.” The super PAC had $164 million remaining in its coffers as of Oct. 14, though it's unclear how much was spent in the weeks leading up to the midterms and how much remains. Wealthy donors poured hundreds of millions into MAGA Inc. — many later benefited from administration decisions — but that money could dry up after Tuesday’s losses. “Raising money could become much harder with Democrats controlling Congress and major donors beginning to look [to turn] their attention toward 2028,” Axios’ report reads. “Republicans say Trump's diminished political clout will make it harder to attract the enormous checks that have flowed into MAGA Inc. The prospect of congressional investigations into alleged pay-for-play arrangements involving donors to Trump's political operation could further discourage contributions.”

articles.title: Zcash resists crypto market selloff as network upgrade goes live. What's next?
articles.description: Zcash showed notable resilience yesterday amid the rout in the crypto market. The NU7 network upgrade might have provided some support. As a reminder, the upgrade reduces block times from 75 seconds to 25 seconds, making payments three times faster. It will also disable older Sprout transaction pools and introduce a Network Sustainability Mechanism aimed at supporting the network's long-term funding. This is an important milestone for Zcash's development. Nevertheless, the macro headwinds will continue to limit the upside. The Democratic Congress is expected to limit fiscal expansion and bring tighter regulation and restriction on AI infrastructure. Since the US economy is leveraged to AI investment, it could lead to a slowdown in growth and weigh on risk sentiment. The wild card is the US-Iran situation. A breakthrough in negotiations would be positive for Zcash on improving growth outlook and risk sentiment. An escalation, on the other hand, will likely trigger another selloff on increasing growth concerns and safe haven flows, although there’s a chance that it could be short-lived if Trump launches limited strikes just to save face before exiting the war. ZCASH TECHNICAL ANALYSIS – DAILY TIMEFRAME On the daily chart, we can see that Zcashis approaching the major resistance zone around the 1,380 level. If the price gets there, we can expect the sellers to step in, with a defined risk above the resistance, to position for a drop into the 1,031 support. The buyers, on the other hand, will want to see the price breaking higher to increase the bullish bets into the 1,692 level next. ZCASH TECHNICAL ANALYSIS – 4 HOUR TIMEFRAME On the 4 hour chart, we have an upward trendline defining the bullish momentum into the resistance. The buyers will likely continue to lean on the trendline, with a defined risk below it, to keep pushing into new highs. The sellers, on the other hand, will look for a break lower to pile in for a drop into the 1,031 support next. ZCASH TECHNICAL ANALYSIS – 1 HOUR TIMEFRAME On the 1 hour chart, there’s not much we can add here as the buyers will continue to lean on the trendline to target new highs, while the sellers will wait for a break below the trendline or a rally into the resistance to position for new lows. The red lines define the average daily range for today. UPCOMING CATALYSTS Todaywe conclude the week with the US NFP report and the University of Michigan Consumer sentiment survey. This article was written by Giuseppe Dellamotta at investinglive.com.

articles.description: Federal judge issues 14-day restraining order on any construction work on Washington monument, hours after it was approved by planning commission A federal judge has halted construction work on Donald Trump’s towering triumphal arch for 14 days, a major setback for one of the president’s most prominent projects in his vision to remake Washington. The temporary restraining order was issued by US district judge Tanya Chutkan in the early hours of Friday. It followed a series of steps taken on Thursday by the government, including the final approval of the 250-foot-high (76-meter) arch by the National Capital Planning Commission in an 8-4 vote after a nine-hour hearing where dozens of witnesses opposed the construction.
